finalText:
**Build's green.** Exit 0, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bump, not the deprecation noise:

1. [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to match.
2. [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) threw on `undefined` flags. The new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made that case default to disabled.

Remaining 8 `WARN DEP0*` lines are just deprecation noise from the bump, not blockers.
